# 1.2.114 - The Infiltrate tile: Listen becomes Infiltrate, a window of rows; Tail Someone and Dash, each rolled on the GMs' record; one event of a settled crossing on the primary GM

Stage E69, built on 1.2.113 (E93) on the same work line. Its commits are C1 eba2b65, C2 5d2e2ab, C5 8b83fb8, the
handbooks 2b5f594, the fix 33e5379, C3+C4 9b58219 and the fix 68f8039; two later parts sit among E74's commits on the
same line: the Stained Glass drawings of the Tail and Dash rows (a123ff1) and the Reroll's branches for a Dash and a
tail (68ec08d). In plain words:

- **The Infiltrate tile.** The tile that held Listen is named **Infiltrate** in English and Polish (its key stays
  `listen`, no migration). It opens a window of rows, one row an action, each with its price: **Listen**, **Tail
  Someone** and **Dash** in this release (E74 adds four more, in 1.2.115). Listen is greyed with its reason in a room
  with no neighbour; before, the warning came after the press.
- **Dash.** A Leg roll, drawn on the primary GM's browser; the GM grants the free crossings its band earns, off its own
  record of the roll.
- **Tail Someone.** Two rolls, both drawn on the GM: a Shadow roll against 15 decides whether the target learns of
  it (on a miss the target's owners are told the tailer's name at once), and the effect roll, Leg or Shadow, a GM's
  pick on the statistics card. The GM keeps the tail; each time the target's crossing settles, the tailer gets a
  card naming the room the target reached - live, in an Eclipse too. A critical effect roll names who stands in that
  room, outside an Eclipse only. One active tail per tailer, no daily limit. The tail ends when it is lost (the tailer
  stands in neither room at the target's settled crossing), at the day's end, at a body found, and when the target
  shakes it with a Dash (a Dash total above the tail's, or a critical; a critical tail only to a critical Dash);
  silently at a death or an incident.
- **A settled crossing**, `crossingSettled`: one event on the primary GM, scheduled from the GMs' record of every
  crossing, that the tail's cards (and in 1.2.115 the doors and Keep Watch) are read from.

Nothing in this version ran at a real table or on a Foundry server; what was measured was measured headless. Below,
an R number names one of the module's own tests (`game.drpg.runTests()`), and a scenario one of the headless
harness's multi-browser runs.

## Before installing

- **No world migration.** No clause was added to `migrate.mjs`, and no language key of the module's was removed or
  renamed. The tile's label changes to Infiltrate in both languages; its key and Listen's approved description stay.
- **New stored data**: one GM store, `tails` (who tails whom, the rolls' totals, kept in the GMs' browsers).
- **Two new bridge roads**, `dash.settle` and `tail.start`, each judged on the primary GM like every request of a
  player's browser. With no GM connected, neither action can be taken, and nothing is paid.

## A Reroll of a Dash or a tail (part of E74 C7, 68ec08d)

- Until 68ec08d, a Reroll of either fell to reroll.mjs's `default`: "this roll left no lasting effect", and the first
  result stood. Now infiltrate-reroll.mjs replays each on the primary GM from the facts the GMs' run wrote on the
  roll's row. A Dash: the new band's crossings granted up to it, or those still left taken down to it; spent ones are
  not taken back. A tail: its strength the new total and critical, where the tail still stands on the same target;
  otherwise the line says the tail is gone.
- Red first: E74-T6 and E74-T7 on a worktree of a123ff1 with only tests-tier2.mjs copied in, every case the no-replay
  line; on the tree "6 passed". The numbers for the whole commit are in 1.2.115's notes.

## The owner's answers

- The decisions the plan names (as it records them, translated, docs/dev/plans/E69.md): DA8, DA19, DA32 - Tail Someone
  is two rolls, Shadow decides whether the target learns, the effect on Leg or Shadow (the player proposes, the GM
  approves); DA20 - cards during the Eclipse, live, rooms only; DA21 - Shadow 15 as in Palm, on a miss the target gets
  the tailer's name at once; DA26 - no daily limit, one active tail per tailer; DA27, DB40 - the label "Infiltrate",
  the key `listen` stays, the name "Tail Someone"; DA28, DA48 - all new actions in one tile, no groups; DA33 - Tail
  Someone in the Night Eclipse as in any Eclipse; DA42 - the Mastermind through a seal or a GM's lock gives the tailer
  an ordinary card.
- **12.11.2026**, on the shots of E93, E69 and E74, as the coordinator relayed it: "na razie wygladaja dobrze". No
  changes asked.
- Defaults taken, each "default, owner may revise" (the coordinator, 12.11.2026; docs/dev/e69/STATUS.md and SPEC.md):
  the ear glyph kept, Listen's approved description kept, Dash's bands; a tail cannot be begun in an Eclipse, and one
  begun keeps sending cards through every Eclipse (**confirmed by the owner, 12.11.2026: "Tak"**, through the
  coordinator); "range" read as above (lost when the tailer stands in neither room);
  the day's end is the clock's day, not the time of day; a critical effect roll names who stands in the room reached
  (no Monocub, Monokuma, hidden token or body the GMs hold dead), outside an Eclipse only; refused also in an
  investigation and for a target the GMs hold dead; a tail's card names the room reached by its region name, even a
  room the tailer never entered (Listen's window says "Unexplored room").
